title: RIHC: Disney's Legacy, with Bob Iger

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome to this very special Rest is History bonus episode with the head of Disney, Bob Iger.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听这期非常特别的《历史的余烬》特别节目，嘉宾是迪士尼首席执行官鲍勃·艾格。

sentences.en: Now, Tom, normally our bonus episodes are only for members of our much-loved Rest is History Club.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，通常我们的特别节目只面向备受喜爱的“历史的余烬俱乐部”会员。

sentences.en: But this one is a little bit different, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但这一期有点不同，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, so this week we've done two episodes on Disney.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这周我们制作了两期关于迪士尼的节目。

sentences.en: We looked at the man himself and we looked at Disneyland.
sentences.zh: 我们探讨了沃尔特本人，也探讨了迪士尼乐园。

sentences.en: And also, of course, if you're a member of the club, you would have got to listen to the Coda to our epic series on Nelson,
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你是俱乐部的会员，你肯定也听过了我们关于纳尔逊宏大系列的尾声，

sentences.en: where we talked about what happened to Lady Emma Hamilton after Nelson's death.
sentences.zh: 在那期节目里，我们聊了纳尔逊死后埃玛·汉密尔顿夫人的经历。

sentences.en: But in this special bonus episode, we are with Bob Iger and we are discussing with him Walt Disney's legacy with the man who now runs Disney.
sentences.zh: 但在今天这个特别的加更节目中，我们请到了鲍勃·艾格，将与这位现任迪士尼掌门人共同探讨沃尔特·迪士尼的传奇。

sentences.en: So a very unusual bonus episode for us.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这是一期非常不同寻常的特别节目。

sentences.en: A bonus bonus episode, in fact.
sentences.zh: 确切地说，是一期“特别中的特别”节目。

sentences.en: Hope you enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 希望你们喜欢。

sentences.en: So, Bob, here we are.
sentences.zh: 那么，鲍勃，我们到了。

sentences.en: Amazing setting.
sentences.zh: 环境太棒了。

sentences.en: Stage one here at Burbank.
sentences.zh: 这里是伯班克的一号摄影棚。

sentences.en: And we've just come from Walt's office, which you showed us.
sentences.zh: 我们刚从你带我们参观过的沃尔特办公室过来。

sentences.en: And you're one of, I guess, really three people in the majority of Disney's history who've run the company.
sentences.zh: 我想，在迪士尼漫长的历史中，真正执掌过这家公司的其实大概只有三个人。

sentences.en: And, I mean, no offense, but you're not going to be running it forever.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，无意冒犯，但你总不可能永远掌管下去吧。

sentences.en: No offense, take it.
sentences.zh: 无意冒犯，我接受了。

sentences.en: Okay, that's good.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那挺好。

sentences.en: I hope I'm not.
sentences.zh: 希望我不会永远掌管。

sentences.en: So, what do you think, you know, we've talked a lot about Walt's legacy,
sentences.zh: 那么，你怎么看，我们聊了很多关于沃尔特的传奇，

sentences.en: but what do you think your legacy will be when you look back on your time as the kind of custodian of this amazing, well, the captain of this fantastic ship?
sentences.zh: 但当你回首自己作为这个伟大王国的守护者——或者说这艘奇妙巨轮的船长——的这段时光时，你认为你的传奇会是什么？

sentences.en: Yes, I think about this often, actually.
sentences.zh: 是的，我其实经常思考这个问题。

sentences.en: I think because of the company's place in the world, I think the person running the company has a special responsibility of sorts to maintain Disney's position in the world.
sentences.zh: 我认为，由于这家公司在世界上的地位，掌管公司的人肩负着一种特殊的责任，去维护迪士尼在世界上的地位。

sentences.en: As a beloved company, as an admired company, as a company that entertains really the world, everyone of all ages and, you know, from all different walks of life.
sentences.zh: 作为一个备受喜爱的公司，一个令人仰慕的公司，一个真正为全世界、为各个年龄段以及各行各业的人们带来娱乐的公司。

sentences.en: And I think more than anything else, I would want to be known as someone who was given the keys to this kingdom, so to speak, and quite a kingdom it is.
sentences.zh: 我觉得最重要的是，我希望自己被称为一个“拿到这个王国钥匙”的人，可以这么说，这确实是一个巨大的王国。

sentences.en: And that I brought it to a place that even Walt would be proud of.
sentences.zh: 并且我把这个王国带到了一个甚至能让沃尔特引以为傲的高度。

sentences.en: And what that means is more great storytelling to a larger audience, more innovation, more risk-taking, more really creation of happiness.
sentences.zh: 这意味着为更多的受众带去更棒的故事、更多的创新、更多的冒险，以及真正创造更多的快乐。

sentences.en: It's really that simple.
sentences.zh: 就是这么简单。

sentences.en: At one point, I thought, well, okay, you're now running Disney.
sentences.zh: 有那么一刻，我想，好吧，你现在在掌管迪士尼了。

sentences.en: What's the most you want out of it?
sentences.zh: 你对它最大的期望是什么？

sentences.en: Well, don't screw it up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，别把它搞砸了。

sentences.en: But it's much more than that.
sentences.zh: 但远不止于此。

sentences.en: I really have been mindful of the duty that I feel has been handed to me to make it even better than it's ever been.
sentences.zh: 我一直谨记着肩负的责任，要把公司做得比以往任何时候都更好。

sentences.en: And what do you think the years ahead hold for Disney?
sentences.zh: 你认为迪士尼的未来几年会是怎样的？

sentences.en: Because you've been at the forefront of so much technological change, going back to Walt and effectively inventing animation, as we were talking about earlier.
sentences.zh: 因为你一直站在众多技术变革的最前沿，从沃尔特开始，正如我们刚才讨论的那样，实际上发明了动画。

sentences.en: But also, you're a company rooted in history.
sentences.zh: 但同时，你们也是一家根植于历史的公司。

sentences.en: So how do you think Disney and your successors will navigate that?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为迪士尼和你的继任者将如何应对这一点？

sentences.en: As I think you would both probably agree, it's hard to project 50 years ahead about anything, really, because the world is changing so rapidly and in such profound ways.
sentences.zh: 我想你们俩大概也会同意，实际上很难预测任何事未来50年的发展，因为世界变化太快、太深刻了。

sentences.en: As I think about the future, one,
sentences.zh: 当我思考未来时，第一，

sentences.en: I would hope that my successors would be respectful of our past and well aware of the values that really created the value of the company in the first place and carry them forward.
sentences.zh: 我希望我的继任者能够尊重我们的过去，深刻理解那些最初为公司创造价值的价值观，并将其发扬光大。

sentences.en: But not let anything that's been done in the future, but not let anything that's been done in the past get in the way of bringing the company into the future.
sentences.zh: 但不要让过去所做的一切，阻碍公司迈向未来。

sentences.en: And that's really constant innovation, a constant exploration, you know, constant, essentially, desire to reinvent or to invent, even.
sentences.zh: 这实际上就是不断的创新、不断的探索，你知道的，基本上就是不断渴望重塑甚至发明。

sentences.en: More than anything else, that's what I'd want.
sentences.zh: 比什么都重要的是，这正是我所期望的。

sentences.en: But I think we do occupy a place in the world as great storytellers, perhaps maybe the greateSt.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们在世界上确实占据着伟大的讲故事者的地位，或许是世界上最伟大的。

sentences.en: And I would hope that that position would continue for years and years, decades ahead.
sentences.zh: 我希望这种地位能够在未来的岁月和几十年里一直持续下去。

sentences.en: And talking of great storytellers, obviously, we're very out of character, Tom, but it's not to talk about ourselves in this context.
sentences.zh: 说到伟大的讲故事者，显然，汤姆，我们现在有点“出戏”了，但这并不是为了在这种语境下谈论我们自己。

sentences.en: So how did you get into the rest of this history, could I ask?
sentences.zh: 所以我想问，你是怎么开始听《历史的余烬》的？

sentences.en: Well, actually, a colleague of mine here at Disney, Christina Shockey, who was our chief communications officer and is a history buff, I think recommended it initially.
sentences.zh: 其实，是我在迪士尼的一位同事克里斯蒂娜·肖基，她是我们的首席通讯官，也是个历史迷，我想最初是她推荐的。

sentences.en: We share an interest in nonfiction, particularly books about history.
sentences.zh: 我们都对非虚构作品感兴趣，尤其是历史类书籍。

sentences.en: And she was the first that suggested I listen to it.
sentences.zh: 她是第一个建议我收听的人。

sentences.en: And I think during COVID, it served a great purpose.
sentences.zh: 我想在疫情期间，它发挥了很大的作用。

sentences.en: I went for many walks and like to listen to a variety of different things, podcasts and music.
sentences.zh: 我散过很多步，喜欢听各种各样的内容，比如播客和音乐。

sentences.en: And it was just a wonderful way to occupy time in what was obviously a pretty tricky time of our lives.
sentences.zh: 在显然是我们生活中相当艰难的一段时期里，这是一个打发时间的绝妙方式。

sentences.en: And are there particular subjects from history that have really fired your imagination?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪些特定的历史题材真正点燃了你的想象力？

sentences.en: This is a commercial for the rest of history, I guess.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是在为《历史的余烬》做广告。

sentences.en: We're all in favor of that.
sentences.zh: 我们都很乐意这么做。

sentences.en: What I love about it is that, one, it gives me the ability to tap into things that I've already been interested in and I know a little bit about.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它的原因在于，第一，它让我能够重温那些我一直感兴趣并且略知一二的事情。

sentences.en: And you teach me more, but you also introduced me to subjects that I wouldn't have been even curious about.
sentences.zh: 你们教给我更多知识，同时也向我介绍了那些我甚至不会去好奇的题材。

sentences.en: The recent one about Marie Antoinette comes to mind.
sentences.zh: 最近关于玛丽·安托瓦内特的那期节目就浮现在脑海里。

sentences.en: On the other hand, I was always fascinated with the Titanic.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我对泰坦尼克号一直充满着迷。

sentences.en: And your multi-parter on the Titanic filled in so many blanks for me and created so much more context.
sentences.zh: 你们关于泰坦尼克号的多集节目填补了我的许多空白，并创造了如此多的背景信息。

sentences.en: I also am an aficionado of certainly American history, particularly American presidents.
sentences.zh: 我当然也是美国历史的爱好者，尤其是美国总统史。

sentences.en: So the assassination of Lincoln comes to mind as one that I was particularly interested in.
sentences.zh: 所以林肯遇刺案让我想起了一个我特别感兴趣的话题。

sentences.en: One that I recently listened to about Reagan and the attempt on his life.
sentences.zh: 我最近听了一集关于里根及其遇刺未遂事件的节目。

sentences.en: I also found interesting looking back, I think, at 1968 and Nixon and the anti-Vietnam movement.
sentences.zh: 回顾过去，我也觉得1968年、尼克松以及反越战运动很有趣。

sentences.en: And, of course, Custer, which was one of the all-time greats.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有卡斯特，这是史上最棒的节目之一。

sentences.en: I don't know, is that over yet?
sentences.zh: 我不知道，那个还没结束吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: 133 parts.
Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Still going strong.
sentences.zh: 依然势头强劲。

sentences.en: He eventually died, fortunately, I guess.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，他最后还是死了，我想。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I think we still carried on after he died.
sentences.zh: 我想在他死后我们还在继续播。

sentences.en: So to give you a sense of how the rest of this issue worked, this is not a production process that I would recommend at Disney.
sentences.zh: 为了让你们感受一下《历史的余烬》是如何制作的，这不是一个我会在迪士尼推荐的制作流程。

sentences.en: We were originally scheduled to do one episode, which would be 55 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们最初计划做一集，时长55分钟。

sentences.en: And there was a point at which we'd reached, we'd done about eight or nine.
sentences.zh: 但有一次我们做到大约第八集或第九集的时候，

sentences.en: And Theo and Tabby, our producers, left their mics on and they were, I could hear them bitterly complaining that the series had now swollen to about 10 hours.
sentences.zh: 西奥和塔比，我们的制作人，忘记关麦克风了，我能听到他们 bitterly 抱怨这个系列现在已经膨胀到了大约10个小时。

sentences.en: Because I think originally we were going to do the entire history of Native Americans in four episodes.
sentences.zh: 因为我想我们最初打算用四集讲完整部美洲原住民史。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And that just proved impossible.
sentences.zh: 结果证明这根本不可能。

sentences.en: It did prove impossible.
sentences.zh: 确实证明不可能。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Not a model for Disney planners.
sentences.zh: 这不是迪士尼规划者的榜样。

sentences.en: Would you have any areas of history or themes that you would particularly like us to explore?
sentences.zh: 你有没有特别希望我们探索的历史领域或主题？

sentences.en: Well, I've studied and read a lot about Churchill, and I know you've touched on Churchill here and there, but I don't think you've ever done a full birth to death of Churchill.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我研究和阅读了很多关于丘吉尔的书，我知道你们在这里或那里触及过丘吉尔，但我觉得你们从来没有做过一期完整的丘吉尔生平全传。

sentences.en: We've done young Churchill, but we have been talking about carrying his life forward, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 我们做过年轻时的丘吉尔，但我们一直在讨论把他的生平继续讲下去，不是吗？

sentences.en: And our competing impressions of Churchill.
sentences.zh: 还有我们对丘吉尔相互交织的印象。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think that's what the public really wants.
sentences.zh: 我想这正是公众真正想听的。

sentences.en: He was, you know, he was maybe a larger than life figure to Americans, too, at least Americans born when I was born.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对美国人来说，他或许是一个超越现实的人物，至少对像我这样出生的人来说是这样的。

sentences.en: I was born in 1951.
sentences.zh: 我出生于1951年。

sentences.en: And so he was not only very much alive, but very much active in politics still.
sentences.zh: 所以他不仅还活着，而且在政坛依然非常活跃。

sentences.en: And I still remember him coming to the United States for the funeral of John F.
sentences.zh: 我仍然记得他来到美国参加约翰·F·肯尼迪的葬礼，

sentences.en: Kennedy and thinking, here's a man that was born, I believe, in Victorian England, attending the funeral of a man who was one of the youngest presidents ever elected.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，这是一个出生于维多利亚时代英国的人，竟然在参加一位有史以来最年轻当选总统的葬礼。

sentences.en: I just remember thinking about that span of history.
sentences.zh: 我只记得自己当时在思考那段历史跨度。

sentences.en: We did a series on the assassination of JFK and kind of looking at his early life.
sentences.zh: 我们做过一个关于肯尼迪遇刺案的系列，算是回顾了他的早年生活。

sentences.en: And I hadn't properly appreciated the way in which he was knitted in to, you know, the world of high society in Britain.
sentences.zh: 我以前没有充分意识到他是如何融入英国上流社会圈子的。

sentences.en: So he would probably, I mean, he knew Churchill before the war.
sentences.zh: 所以他可能，我是说他在战前就认识丘吉尔。

sentences.en: His sister married someone who then married a Mitford.
sentences.zh: 他的姐姐嫁给了一个人，那个人后来又娶了一位米特福德家族的人。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: I can't remember exactly.
sentences.zh: 我记不太清了。

sentences.en: His father was ambassador.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是大使。

sentences.en: He was then to the court of St. James.
sentences.zh: 他后来去了圣詹姆斯宫廷担任大使。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And also had a thing or two to say about the rise of Nazism, which is, now I know that's something that you've also covered.
sentences.zh: 而且他对纳粹主义的崛起也有一番见解，现在我知道这也是你们探讨过的内容。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Now, that's something we're always asked by our Rest is History Club members, our beloved members of the Rest is History Club.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是我们的《历史的余烬》俱乐部会员、我们挚爱的俱乐部成员经常问我们的问题。

sentences.en: They always ask us, Tom, who would you like to have dinner with from history?
sentences.zh: 汤姆，他们总是问我们，你想和历史上的哪个人共进晚餐？

sentences.en: Bob, it would be remiss of us not to ask you.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃，如果我们不问你，那就太失职了。

sentences.en: So if you could have anybody from history for dinner, you could take them to Disneyland and have dinner with them, who would it be?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你能邀请历史上的任何人共进晚餐，你可以带他们去迪士尼乐园共进晚餐，那会是谁？

sentences.en: Well, it would have to be Walt Disney.
sentences.zh: 那一定得是沃尔特·迪士尼。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think about it often.
sentences.zh: 我经常这样想。

sentences.en: People always ask me, what would Walt think?
sentences.zh: 人们总是问我，沃尔特会怎么想？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, it's interesting, too,
sentences.zh: 你知道，这也很有趣，

sentences.en: because one of the things that was problematic for the company after Walt died so suddenly in 1966 is the company spent so much time asking that question,
sentences.zh: 因为在1966年沃尔特突然去世后，公司面临的问题之一就是大家花了太多时间在问这个问题：

sentences.en: what would Walt do or what would Walt think?
sentences.zh: 沃尔特会怎么做，或者沃尔特会怎么想？

sentences.en: So I'm not really interested in turning to him for advice, per se, but I would be more interested in showing him what's become of the great company that he founded.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不是真的有兴趣向他寻求建议本身，我更感兴趣的是向他展示他所创立的伟大公司如今变成了什么样子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't mind a bit of a report card, perhaps it's cocky of me to think that he would give me all A's.
sentences.zh: 而且我也不介意拿一次成绩单，虽然我自以为他会给我全A，这可能有点自大。

sentences.en: Which of the rides do you think he'd be most impressed by?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他会对哪一个游乐设施印象最深刻？

sentences.en: Well, you know, he is, I know because you've done a little studying of Walt, he never even considered them rides.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，据我所知——因为你对沃尔特做过一些研究——他从来不把这些叫做游乐设施。

sentences.en: They were all stories to him.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这些全都是故事。

sentences.en: They were experiences.
sentences.zh: 这些都是体验。

sentences.en: He wasn't building rides.
sentences.zh: 他造的不是游乐设施。

sentences.en: And many of the, not just traditions, but values that he created and essentially built, we followed basically through on essentially either his instructions or his vision.
sentences.zh: 而且许多传统，不仅是传统，还有他创立并基本建立的价值观，我们基本上都是按照他的指示或愿景来贯彻执行的。

sentences.en: And so when we create attractions, we try to tell stories when we create attractions.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们打造游乐项目时，我们在打造游乐项目的同时也在试图讲述故事。

sentences.en: Even when we create restaurants and hotels, there's a story behind it.
sentences.zh: 即使在我们建造餐厅和酒店时，背后也有一个故事。

sentences.en: And in particular, I'd love to show him what we built that's derived from Star Wars mythology.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我很想向他展示我们基于《星球大战》神话打造的园区。

sentences.en: We call the lands Galaxy's Edge.
sentences.zh: 我们把这片土地命名为“银河边缘”。

sentences.en: There's one in Florida and one in his beloved Disneyland.

sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你们去研究历史的其余部分，而我们来建造主题公园，对吧？

sentences.en: I suspect it probably is.
sentences.zh: 我猜大概确实如此。

sentences.en: Um, I thought it was just practical for us to allow facial hair and, you know, we still have grooming standards, by the way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得允许留面部毛发对我们来说只是很实用的一点，而且，你知道，我们顺便说一句还是有仪容标准的。

sentences.en: Um, you know, we haven't, uh, you know, completely abandoned our desire to show up looking good.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们并没有，呃，你知道，完全放弃展现良好外表的愿望。

sentences.en: Very like us at the rest of history, Tom.
sentences.zh: 这很像我们研究历史的人的做法，汤姆。

sentences.en: Very like.
sentences.zh: 非常像。

sentences.en: So Bob, thank you so much for giving us this time.
sentences.zh: 那么鲍勃，非常感谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Um, but the torture for you is not over yet because you're taking us-
sentences.zh: 嗯，不过对你的折磨还没结束，因为你要带我们——

sentences.en: Fresh excitement's to come.
sentences.zh: 更新鲜的刺激还在后头呢。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You're taking us to Disneyland and I have to say, I cannot wait.
sentences.zh: 你要带我们去迪士尼乐园，我必须说，我都等不及了。

sentences.en: But thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 但真的非常感谢。

sentences.en: Well, you're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: It's not torture for me, obviously.
sentences.zh: 对我来说这显然不是折磨。

sentences.en: If I could spend every day at Disneyland, I would be a very happy fellow.
sentences.zh: 如果我能把每一天都在迪士尼乐园度过，我就会是一个非常快乐的家伙。

sentences.en: Thanks very much for listening.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: And as you heard in this episode, after that interview, Dominic and I went to Disneyland
sentences.zh: 正如你在本期节目中所听到的，那次采访之后，多米尼克和我去了迪士尼乐园，

sentences.en: and you can watch footage of that visit and our tour of Walt Disney's office on YouTube now.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以在YouTube上观看这次访问的影像以及我们参观华特·迪士尼办公室的视频。

sentences.en: Simply click the link in this episode's description or head to YouTube and search for The Rest Is History.
sentences.zh: 只需点击本期节目简介中的链接，或者前往YouTube搜索《The Rest Is History》。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I really advise people to do that because they'll see the greatest moment in the history of The Rest Is History,
sentences.zh: 我强烈建议大家去看看，因为你们会看到《The Rest Is History》历史上最伟大的时刻，

sentences.en: which is our producer, Theo Youngsmith, being, uh, detained by storm troopers at Disneyland.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们的制作人西奥·杨史密斯（Theo Youngsmith）在迪士尼乐园被冲锋队员扣留。

sentences.en: And you would expect Theo to sort of respond to this in a very swashbuckling and macho manner.
sentences.zh: 你本会期望西奥以一种非常侠义和有男子气概的方式来应对这件事。

sentences.en: But actually, as you'll see, if you watch the film, uh, his actual reaction is very different.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，如果你看了这段影像就会发现，呃，他真正的反应非常不同。

sentences.en: Luke Skywalker.
sentences.zh: 卢克·天行者。

sentences.en: He was not.
sentences.zh: 他并不是。

sentences.en: He was not.
sentences.zh: 他绝对不是。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: More C3PO, I would say.
sentences.zh: 更像是C-3PO，我想可以说。

sentences.en: So, listen, we will be back next week with an extraordinarily swashbuckling and exciting series on the life of the young Elizabeth the firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，听着，我们下周将带着一个极其侠义且精彩的关于年轻伊丽莎白一世生平的系列节目回归。

sentences.en: So, if you're a member of The Rest Is History Club, you'll actually get all four episodes of that series on Monday.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是《The Rest Is History》俱乐部的会员，你实际上在周一就能收听到该系列的所有四集节目。

sentences.en: The rest of you, I'm afraid, will have to wait.
sentences.zh: 至于剩下的各位，恐怕就得等一等了。

sentences.en: And a final reminder, if you want to see Tom enjoying himself on the Pirates of the Caribbean ride and Theo Youngsmith being arrested at Galaxy's Edge,
sentences.zh: 最后再提醒一下，如果你想看汤姆在加勒比海盗游乐设施上玩得开心，以及西奥·杨史密斯在银河边缘园区被捕，

sentences.en: then click the link in this episode's description or head to YouTube and search for The Rest Is History.
sentences.zh: 那就点击本期节目简介中的链接，或者前往YouTube搜索《The Rest Is History》。

sentences.en: And believe me, you will not regret it.
sentences.zh: 相信我，你绝对不会后悔的。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
